sentences.text: Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. Thru.Prin.Secy. Home

Counsel for Applicant :- Ajeet Kumar Singh Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Subhash Vidyarthi,J.
Heard Sri Ajeet Kumar Singh, the learned counsel for the applicant, Sri Manoj Kumar Sahu, the learned A.G.A. for the State and Sri Suresh Kumar Yadav, the learned counsel for the informant and perused the record.

The instant application has been filed seeking bail for the applicant in Case Crime no. 589 of 2022,
under Section 376, 504, 506 I.P.C., registered at Police Station Jaidpur, District Barabanki.
The aforesaid case has been registered on the basis of F.I.R. lodged on 16.12.2022 stating that the applicant lives in the neighborhood of the informant and a love affair was going on between them since long; that under a promise to marry the informant, the applicant used to physically exploit her and he prepared obscene photos and videos of the informant and used to threaten the informant that he would spread those photos and videos at social sites.

The F.I.R. categorically states that the informant pleaded the applicant that she was a married lady and the applicant should not exploit her else her marriage will breakdown but the applicant did not accede to her request and kept on raping her off and on and he also committed unnatural sex with the informant.

sentences.text: In the affidavit filed in support of the bail application, it has been stated that the applicant is innocent, he has been falsely implicated in the present case and he has no criminal history.

In the statement of the informant recorded under Section 161 Cr.P.C., she reiterated the F.I.R.
averments and stated that she was having a love affair with the applicant for the past three years.

In the medico legal examination report of the informant, no external injury has been reported on any part of her body and the pathological examination report also does not supports the allegation of rape.
In the statement of the victim recorded under Section 164 Cr.P.C. also, the informant reiterated the F.I.R. averments and she further stated that her marriage with Ram Narayan has broken down.

The Learned A.G.A. has filed a counter affidavit opposing the prayer for bail of the applicant and a copy of the charge sheet has been annexed with the affidavit, which has been filed under Sections 376, 504, 506 only and the Investigating Officer has concluded that the allegation of commission of offence under Section 377 I.P.C. was not established.
Having considered the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case and keeping in view the fact that the informant herself has stated that she was in a love affair with the applicant for the past three years; that although it is alleged that the applicant exploited the informant under a false promise of marrying her, the informant herself stated that she was married to some other person and that the allegations of blackmail etc. have not been found to be established during investigation.

Coupled with the fact that the applicant has no criminal history and he is languishing in jail since 24.12.2022,
I am of the view that the applicant is entitled to be released on bail in the aforesaid case.
Accordingly, this bail application stands allowed.
In case of breach of any of the above conditions, the prosecution shall be at liberty to move bail cancellation application before this Court.

. 
(Subhash Vidyarthi,J.) Order Date :- 23.3.2023
Preeti.

opennyai_summary.decision:
Accordingly, this bail application stands allowed.
Let the applicant Vipin Kumar be released on bail in Case Crime no. 589 of 2022, under Section 376,
504, 506 I.P.C., registered at Police Station Jaidpur, District Barabanki on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of magistrate/court concerned,
subject to following conditions: -
(i) the applicant shall not tamper with the prosecution evidence;
(ii) the applicant shall not pressurize the prosecution witnesses;
(iii) the applicant shall appear on each and every date fixed by the trial court.
